name: JVM 调优命令

troubleshooting.cpuHigh: top -Hp → 找线程nid → printf %x → jstack | grep hex → 定位代码
troubleshooting.memoryHigh: jstat -gc → 观察Full GC → jmap -dump → MAT分析 → 找大对象(Dominator Tree)
troubleshooting.oom: jmap -dump → MAT → Dominator Tree → 找占内存最多对象

notes: jps找pid/jinfo查参数/jstat看GC(jstat -gc)/jstack查死锁和CPU高/jmap导出dump; CPU高top+H→jstack, 内存高jmap→MAT
